note: What a server sends to say a unit is swinging at another, carrying where the swinging unit stands as well as what it swings at. The header names the unit acting.

fields.name: targetX
fields.note: Where the unit swung at stands, along one ground axis.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: timing
fields.note: How the swing sits against the unit's own rhythm. 128 in everything observed.

fields.name: missile
fields.note: The name the missile this swing throws will answer to. Zero for a swing that throws none.

fields.name: slot
fields.note: Which of the unit's attacks this is. 64 in everything observed.

fields.name: fromX
fields.note: Where the swinging unit stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: fromZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other, in world units.

fields.name: fromX
fields.note: Where the swinging unit stands, along one ground axis, in world units.

fields.name: fromZ
fields.note: Where it stands, along the other, in world units.
